steps.observed: No console errors reported by agent-browser errors command

assertions.title: WebSocket connection establishes and receives GraphSnapshot

steps.action: Connect to ws://127.0.0.1:3100/ws via Python websockets client
steps.expected: WebSocket connection accepted, first message is server.bootstrap with snapshot
steps.observed: Connection accepted. First message received: WsPush with channel 'server.bootstrap' containing ServerBootstrap payload with embedded snapshot field of type GraphSnapshot

steps.expected: message_type, protocol_version, graph, protocol fields present
steps.observed: snapshot.message_type='GraphSnapshot', snapshot.protocol_version='0.1.0', snapshot.graph (with edges, gates, metadata, nodes, registry), snapshot.protocol (with summary and project sections)

steps.expected: _tag, version (non-empty), projectPath, sessionStatus, desktopEnvironment, replHistory, optional snapshot
steps.observed: All fields present: _tag='ServerBootstrap', version='0.14.0', projectPath='/tmp/glade-test', sessionStatus={_tag:'SessionStatus', state:'ready'}, desktopEnvironment={settings:{...}, preflight:{...}}, replHistory=[], snapshot={...}

verifiedFields: desktopEnvironment: {settings: {rExecutablePath, editorCommand, updateChannel}, preflight: {checkedAt, projectPath, status, issues}}

frictions.description: WebSocket interception via JavaScript injection (window.WebSocket override) does not survive page navigation — the interceptor is lost when navigating from about:blank to the app URL. Had to use a separate Python websockets client to capture WS messages.
frictions.resolution: Used Python websockets library to connect directly to ws://127.0.0.1:3100/ws and capture the bootstrap message independently of the browser.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: all 4 passed. Full stack (Vite, Bun backend, R/bayesgrove) running correctly on expected ports. Health endpoint returns 200. Web app renders complete workspace layout (explorer, canvas, REPL, inspector) with no console errors. WebSocket connection receives server.bootstrap with properly structured ServerBootstrap payload including embedded GraphSnapshot.
